z-m-06-05.title: Ukuba unamathelisa iziqwenga ezimbini zonxantathu, ngaba ihekisagoni?
z-m-06-05.topic: Onxantathu neekhwadrilatera: inani lamacala emo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa iziqwenga
z-m-06-05.goal: Yazi ukuba inani lamacala emo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa iziqwenga ezimbini zonxantathu linokwahluka ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela ezinamathiselwe ngayo, ufumane ulungise inxalenye engalunganga kwingcinga kaSora.
z-m-06-05.material: Kukho iziqwenga zephepha ezi-2 ezimilo yonxantathu one-engile yekona. Ezimbini zinobukhulu nemo efanayo ncam. Amacala amabini akufutshane ne-engile yekona angama-3cm nama-4cm, kwaye icala elide kakhulu li-5cm. I-engile yekona yikona yesikwere, kwaye ukuba udibanisa ii-engile zekona ezimbini, ziba ngumgca othe tye omnye ongagobi. Nameleka ezimbini ncam ecaleni kwelinye, ngaphandle kokugqubana nokuba nesikhewu, ukwenza imo enye. Kungcono ngakumbi ukusika iphepha uzame wena. Funda ingcinga kaSora umgca ngomgca.
z-m-06-05.prereq.0: Amacala nee-engile zekona zonxantathu, iikhwadrilatera, neehekisagoni (inqanaba leBanga 2)
z-m-06-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwingcinga kaSora ongachanekanga.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa ukuba umgca ngamnye ungaphambi kokunamathelisa okanye emva kokunamathelisa kunye.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga imo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa iziqwenga zephepha ezimbini ecaleni elinye, ubale amacala ongawabona ngaphandle omnye ngomnye.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.1: Zimbini, ngoko kukho amacala angama-3+3=6 lilonke.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.2: Xa unamathelisa ezimbini, amacala amabini anamathiselweyo awabonakali ngaphandle.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko imo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa inamacala ama-6.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.line.4: Inamacala ama-6, ngoko nokuba unamathelisa njani, iba yihekisagoni.
z-m-06-05.s.s1.explain: Imigca 4 no-5 ayichanekanga. Umgca 3 wathi amacala amabini anamathiselweyo awabonakali ngaphandle, ngoko amacala abonwa ngaphandle ngama-6 ukususa ezo zimbini. Kodwa umgca 4 awuzange ulibonise oko. U-6 kumgca 2 uchanekile njengenani lamacala phambi kokunamathelisa. Ukuba ukhethe umgca wangaphambili, hlukanisa ukuba loo migca ngaphambi kokunamathelisa okanye emva kokunamathelisa.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, nameleka amacala e-4cm kunye, kodwa guqula isiqwenga esinye ukuze ii-engile zekona ezimbini zidibane kwinqaku elinye. Ukuba ubala amacala abonwa ngaphandle adityaniswe kumgca omnye njengecala elinye, imo eyenziwe ngokunamathelisa yimo enjani?
z-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ukuba amacala amabini e-3cm enza imo enjani apho ii-engile zekona ezimbini zidibana khona.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hamba kanye ujikeleze amacala owabonayo ngaphandle uwakhombe, ubala ezo zidityaniswe kumgca omnye kanye kuphela.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.a: Ucinge ngamacala amabini anamathiselweyo ethi nyamalala, kodwa uphosise ukuba amacala amabini adityaniswe kumgca omnye abonakala njengecala elinye.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.b: Ucinge kunye ukunyamalala kwamacala anamathiselweyo nokubala amacala adityaniswe kumgca omnye njengecala elinye.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.c: Kubonakala ukuba ubale elinye ngaphezulu ngelixa ubala amacala asele. Hamba kanye ujikeleze ngaphandle uwakhombe omnye ngomnye.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.r.d: Usebenzise inani lamacala langaphambi kokunamathelisa njengoko linjalo. Jonga kwakhona okwenzeka kumacala anamathiselweyo.
z-m-06-05.s.s2.explain: Amacala amabini e-4cm anamathiselweyo angena ngaphakathi kwaye awabonakali. Amacala asele ngamacala amabini e-3cm namacala amabini e-5cm. Kodwa kuba ii-engile zekona ezimbini zidibene, amacala amabini e-3cm aba ngumgca othe tye omnye, icala elinye le-6cm. Ngoko ngunxantathu onamacala ama-3.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.prompt: Xelela uSora ukuba kutheni 'nokuba unamathelisa njani, iba yihekisagoni' kungachanekanga. Sebenzisa indlela yokunamathelisa oyijongileyo ngoku njengomzekelo.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ungasebenzisa indlela efanayo yokubala amacala emo oyisebenzise kwinyathelo lokugqibela.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ukuba yimzekelo muni owenza ibinzana elithi 'nokuba unamathelisa njani' libe lingalunganga.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubale amacala abonwa ngaphandle omnye ngomnye kumzekelo wakho?
z-m-06-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale uyazi ukuba umzekelo omnye uphula ibinzana elithi 'nokuba unamathelisa njani'?
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.0: Ayihlali iyihekisagoni. Amacala anamathiselweyo awabonakali ngaphandle, kwaye ukuba unamathelisa amacala e-4cm, inokuba nxantathu.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.1: Ixhomekeke kwindlela onamathelisa ngayo. Ukuba unamathelisa amacala e-5cm, iba yikhwadrilatera enamacala ama-4.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.2: Ukuba unamathelisa amacala e-5 cm, iba yikhwadrilatera, ngoko ayiyiyo ihekisagoni.
z-m-06-05.s.s3.model.3: Ukuba unamathelisa amacala e-4 cm ukuze ii-engile zekona ezimbini zidibane, iba nxantathu onamacala ama-3. Ngoko nokuba unamathelisa njani, ayiyiyo ihekisagoni.

z-m-06-01.title: Ukuba isalathisi seyure sikufutshane ne-5, ingaba yintsimbi ye-5?
z-m-06-01.topic: Iwotshi: ukufunda ixesha ngesalathisi seyure nesalathisi somzuzu
z-m-06-01.goal: Yazi ukuba isalathisi seyure sodwa senza kube nzima ukugqiba ukuba yiyiphi iyure kwaye kufuneka usifunde kunye nesalathisi somzuzu, uze wenze imizekelo yakho yamaxesha apho isalathisi seyure sikufutshane ne-5 kodwa ayikabi yintsimbi ye-5.
z-m-06-01.material: Iwotshi ene-analog inesalathisi seyure (isalathisi esixela iyure) nesalathisi somzuzu (isalathisi esixela imizuzu). Xa isalathisi somzuzu sikhomba kwi-12 kuba kanye kuyure epheleleyo, kwaye isithuba sonombolo ngamnye simizuzu emi-5. Amanani eewotshi ngu-1 ukuya kwi-12. U-Jiho akawuboni ngqo umfanekiso weewotshi kwaye udlala umdlalo wokuqikelela ixesha ngoko umhlobo wakhe amxelela ngamagama. Nokuba yi-a.m. okanye yi-p.m. akubalulekanga.
